column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/slow_field_reads_s1197.onsa tests=13 evaluated=0 unavailable=0 skipped=13 waiting=0
- a field of a tick under a sample condition is the value of the tick whether or not the condition held at the tick
- the field read under a condition is the same value as the field moved to a let
- the whole read first and the field of it under a condition has the same values while no reset has come
- an element of a tuple under a condition is read at every tick
- a nested field under a condition is read at every tick
- the inner struct read first under a condition has the same values while no reset has come
- after a reset the field of the type F32 is F32.default() until the next tick
- after a reset the whole read first is M.default() until the next tick, so its vel is 1.0
- after a reset the element of a tuple is F32.default() until the next tick
- after a reset the nested field is F32.default() (0.0), not the declared default of the struct
- after a reset the whole nested value read first has the declared default vel 1.0
- after a reset the inner struct read first has the declared default vel 1.0
- the copies of a par~ keep a field each
